method: Deterministic evaluation of the empirical restitution polynomial printed in Eq. (26) of the locally audited primary publication

review.method: Second-pass comparison of coefficients, apparatus, page, and equation locator against all nine PDF pages

rounding_policy: Preserve printed coefficients exactly; derived points use IEEE-754 double evaluation serialized with 17 significant digits; coefficient last-place half-units are independent rectangular uncertainties.
uncertainty_interpretation: Independent standard uncertainties propagated from the printed coefficient resolutions; the 0.15 normalized-curve engineering threshold is preregistered separately.
